spans.s: 1. चिद् in comp. for चित्.

2. चिद् ind. even, indeed, also (often merely laying stress on a preceding word; requiring a preceding simple verb to be accentuated [Pāṇ. viii, 1, 57] as well as a verb following, if चिद् is preceded by an interrogative pron. [48]; in Class. only used after interrogative pronouns and adverbs to render them indefinite, and after जातु, q.v.), RV.; VS.; AV.
like (added to the stem of a subst., e.g. अग्नि-, राज-), Nir. i, 4; Pāṇ. viii, 2, 101
or चिद्-च or चिद्-उ, as well as, both-and, RV.
चिद्—अचित् f. ‘thought and non-thought, mind and matter’, in comp.
चिद्—अ˚चिच्-छक्ति-युक्त mfn. having power (शक्ति) over mind and matter, W.
चिद्—अ˚चिन्-मय mfn. consisting of mind and matter, BhP. xi, 24, 7.
चिद्—अम्बर m. N. of the author of a law-book
चिद्—अम्बर n. N. of a town, W.
चिद्—अम्बर—पुर n. id.
चिद्—अम्बर—रहस्य n. N. of wk.
चिद्—अम्बर—स्थल n. = -पुर, Śaṃkar. iv, 7.
चिद्—अस्थि-माला f. N. of a Comm. on a grammatical work.
चिद्—आत्मक mfn. consisting of pure thought, BhP. viii, 3, 2.
चिद्—आत्मन् m. pure thought or intelligence, i, 3, 30; RāmatUp.; Prab.
चिद्—आनन्द ‘thought and joy’, in comp.
चिद्—आनन्द—दश-श्लोकी f. ten verses in praise of thought and joy
चिद्—आनन्द—मय mfn. consisting of thought and joy, RāmatUp.
चिद्—आनन्द—स्तव-राज m. = -दश-श्लोकी
चिद्—आन˚न्दाश्रम m. N. of a teacher (= परमानन्द्˚).
चिद्—उल्लास mfn. shining like thoughts, BhP. ix, 11, 33.
चिद्—गगन-चन्द्रिका f. N. of wk., Ānand. i, Sch.
चिद्—घन m. = -आत्मन्, Sarvad. viii, 78.
चिद्—रत्न-चषक N. of wk.
चिद्—रथ m. N. of a Sāman, ĀrṣBr.
चिद्—रथी f. N. of a Comm.
चिद्—रूप mfn. (Vop. ii, 37) = चिन्-मय, KapS. vi, 50; NṛsUp. (-त्व n. abstr.), Sarvad.
wise, L.
चिद्—रूप n. the Universal Spirit as identified with pure thought, W.
चिद्—रूप—त्व n., abstr.
चिद्—विलास m. N. of a pupil of Śaṃkarācārya, Śaṃkar. iv, 5.
चिद्—वृत्ति f. spiritual action, Daśar. ii, 37.
